item.title: ACLU-SC responds to AG's "brazen attempt at intimidating nonprofits"
item.description: On Jan. 22, 2026, South Carolina Attorney General Alan Wilson sent letters demanding years’ worth of membership lists, meeting minutes, donor records, and other sensitive documents from several nonprofit organizations in South Carolina.

item.title: Why Timeless Style Never Goes Out of Fashion, and Why That Matters Today
item.description: Fashion trends shift faster than ever, yet some styles stick around for decades. We see microtrends explode and disappear within weeks on social media, but certain pieces in our closets still work year after year. It makes you wonder, what really matters in how we dress?

item.title: How the U.S. Government Procurement System Works - and Where the GSA Fits In
item.description: Entering the U.S. government market is appealing for many businesses. The federal government is the largest buyer of goods and services in the world, purchasing everything from office supplies and software to complex professional and technical services. For many companies, a GSA contract represents the most direct path into this market. item.title: South Carolina Aquarium to Close Jan. 31 and Feb. 1 Due to Winter Weather Forecast
item.description: Due to forecasted severe winter weather in the area, the South Carolina Aquarium will be closed Saturday, Jan. 31, and Sunday, Feb. 1. Reopening plans will be shared on the aquarium’s website and social media channels.

item.title: Teddy Swims to Perform at the North Charleston Coliseum in June
item.description: Singer and songwriter Teddy Swims is bringing his Summer 2026 Tour to the North Charleston Coliseum with special guest Marc Scibilia.

item.title: Mac Deford campaign releases grassroots momentum video, announces major endorsements
item.description: The Mac Deford for Congress campaign today released a new campaign video showcasing Deford’s grassroots campaign and the broad community support fueling his campaign across South Carolina’s 1st Congressional District.

item.title: SOBA Gallery & Art School Moving Across Church Street, Reopening March 3
item.description: The Society of Bluffton Artists (SOBA) Gallery and Art School are relocating to a new space in Old Town Bluffton and continuing their mission with the same artists, classes, and creative community that patrons know and love.

item.title: Brandon Brown Unveils Statewide Local Leaders Coalition in U.S. Senate Bid
item.description: U.S. Senate candidate Brandon Brown officially launched a new statewide action group, Local Leaders for Brandon Brown, during a press conference Wednesday morning at Cumberland United Methodist Church in Florence.

item.title: Jeni’s Shares Plans for 2026 Ice Cream for Breakfast Day
item.description: On Saturday, Feb. 7, you’ll want to set your alarm because Jeni's Splendid Ice Creams will host their annual Ice Cream for Breakfast Day (ICFBD) from 9 am to noon.
